title: quest_actions report v1
description: The `quest_actions` block a world carries after POST /world/quest: the report for the call just made, not accumulated state. It is overwritten by the next such call and says nothing about earlier ones -- `quests.log` and `history.operations` are where a sequence is recorded. `applied` is zero for a call that carried no actions, and such a call records no operation.

day.description: The world clock's day at the moment of the call, which is the default any action that named no day was given.

state.description: The lifecycle state the quest holds after this action. These are two of the states terrain_time already writes; this route publishes no new one.
